query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_students,
  COUNT(phone) as has_phone,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN phone IS NULL OR phone = '' THEN 1 END) as no_phone,
  COUNT(password) as has_password,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN password IS NULL THEN 1 END) as no_password
FROM students;
